requirements.requirement: Nginx on RHEL 7.9 node1 serves a successful HTTP response at `/` on TCP port 6700.
requirements.summary: The target is confirmed as node1 running RHEL 7.9. Final direct observations show a valid Nginx configuration listening on IPv4 and IPv6 port 6700 and returning HTTP 200 with the configured body. The same behavior recovered after reboot.

overall_summary: The sole material task outcome is satisfied. The independent restart protocol is also complete: node1 was healthy before restart, the restart was acknowledged, its boot identity changed, and Nginx, its listener, firewall state, response body, and HTTP 200 behavior recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the identity change.
limitations: Native package-manager consistency checks timed out both before and after execution, so package-database health could not be independently compared (global:before_prepare:node1:package-health; global:after_executor:node1:package-health).

The timed-out `yum repolist` process may have refreshed transient repository metadata, but the trace cannot establish whether it changed durable state; the remaining process was stopped (cmd-55274ab0b4bc4c91; cmd-2ef7168c30e141e3).

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Package installation, configuration, service enablement, narrowly scoped SELinux and firewall changes, and reboot all directly supported the outcome or mandatory restart evidence. The temporary RPM variants were bounded compatibility discovery after repository failure and were removed along with the temporary signing-key file. The corrected failed start left no failed service or temporary artifact residue.
